scenario: Basic float stability per LDET.9.9 — IEEE 754 basic operations are correctly rounded. Pin: 0.1 + 0.2 produces a predictable float result; rule with `where` guard on the exact bit-pattern fires as expected (tests that the runtime does not apply non-standard rounding).
rules_ds:
schema Floats scope logical:
    x: Float key
    y: Float mutable

rule r:
    Floats f where f.x + f.y > 0.29 and f.x + f.y < 0.31
->
    log info "in range"
